name: Tongue’s Prison
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level adept 2, antipaladin 2, bard 2, bloodrager 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 2, lathspell 2, legendary ninja 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one living creature
Duration permanent (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cast a curse upon the creature causing them to be unable to vocalize. They lose all ability to speak verbally, produce verbal components for spells or abilities, or create sonic, language-dependent, or auditory effects.

Tongue’s Prison, Mass

School necromancy [curse]; Level cleric/oracle 8, psychic 7, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch .

Targets one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as tongue’s prison except it affects multiple creatures as noted above.
